title: GAS-PFN: Graph-Aware Spatiotemporal Prior-Data Fitted Networks for Zero-Shot Traffic Forecasting
abstract: arXiv:2610.37598v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Traffic forecasting requires modeling complex temporal dynamics and the spatial dependencies imposed by road topology. Supervised graph-based models achieve strong performance, but are often trained for a particular dataset and sensor graph, making deployment to new or evolving networks costly. Prior-Data Fitted Networks (PFNs) offer a zero-shot alternative by learning in-context inference from synthetic task priors, which provide an explicit mechanism for encoding domain-specific assumptions. Existing forecasting PFNs, however, do not explicitly represent the graph-structured dependencies governing traffic dynamics. To combine graph-aware traffic modeling with zero-shot adaptation, we introduce the Graph-Aware Spatiotemporal Prior-Data Fitted Network (GAS-PFN). GAS-PFN incorporates sampled road topology into its synthetic task prior through random-walk diffusion, teaching the model to learn graph-coupled dynamics during pretraining. I

translated_title: GAS-PFN：用于零样本交通预测的图感知时空先验数据拟合网络
translated_abstract: 交通预测需要对复杂的时间动态以及由道路拓扑结构所施加的空间依赖关系进行建模。有监督的基于图的模型虽然取得了优异的性能，但通常针对特定数据集和传感器图进行训练，使得将其部署到新网络或不断演化的网络时成本高昂。先验数据拟合网络（Prior-Data Fitted Networks, PFNs）通过从合成任务先验中学习上下文推理，提供了一种零样本替代方案，并为编码领域特定假设提供了显式机制。然而，现有的预测类PFN并未显式表示支配交通动态的图结构依赖关系。为了将图感知的交通建模与零样本自适应相结合，我们提出了图感知时空先验数据拟合网络（GAS-PFN）。GAS-PFN通过随机游走扩散将采样的道路拓扑结构融入其合成任务先验中，从而教会模型在预训练期间学习图耦合的动态特性。
tldr: GAS-PFN通过随机游走扩散将道路拓扑融入合成任务先验，提出了显式建模图结构依赖的图感知时空PFN，实现了无需针对特定网络训练的零样本交通预测。
en_tdlr: GAS-PFN incorporates road topology into synthetic task priors via random-walk diffusion, enabling graph-aware zero-shot traffic forecasting without dataset-specific training.
